from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer from html import escape from urllib.parse import parse_qs MAX_BODY_SIZE = 1_000_000 def render_page(message="", submitted=False): escaped_message = escape(message, quote=True) result = ( f"

You entered:

{escaped_message}

" if submitted else "" ) return f""" Input Form

{result} """ class FormHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def send_html(self, status, content): body = content.encode("utf-8") self.send_response(status) self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8") self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))) self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff") self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(body) def do_GET(self): self.send_html(200, render_page()) def do_POST(self): try: content_length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0")) except ValueError: self.send_html(400, render_page()) return if content_length < 0: self.send_html(400, render_page()) return if content_length > MAX_BODY_SIZE: self.send_html(413, render_page()) return body = self.rfile.read(content_length) try: fields = parse_qs( body.decode("utf-8"), keep_blank_values=True, strict_parsing=False, ) except UnicodeDecodeError: self.send_html(400, render_page()) return message = fields.get("message", [""])[0] self.send_html(200, render_page(message, submitted=True)) def log_message(self, format_string, *args): super().log_message(format_string, *args) def run_server(host="127.0.0.1", port=8000): server = ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), FormHandler) print(f"Serving on http://{host}:{port}") try: server.serve_forever() except KeyboardInterrupt: pass finally: server.server_close() if __name__ == "__main__": run_server()
